Y

Fixed by someone who'll still be here next year

I started Yash Mobile Solution because most repair counters in Vaishali Nagar would quote a price, then find "extra problems" once your phone was already in pieces. That's not how we work — you get one honest number before anything is opened up.

Every board that comes across this table gets tested on the multimeter, not guessed at. If a part isn't genuine-grade, we tell you before we fit it, and if a repair isn't worth the money compared to a new phone, we'll say that too.

  • Diagnosis done in front of you, no black-box repairs
  • Genuine-grade parts, never mixed with your knowledge
  • 90-day warranty on every repair, in writing
  • Most common repairs finished same visit
